name: Run All Model Tests
description: Runs capability tests for all available models from the LLM Provider. Stores results in the Knowledge Base for each model.

inputs.name: Test Categories
inputs.description: Comma-separated list of categories to test, or 'all'

inputs.name: LLM Provider URL
inputs.description: URL of the LLM Provider API

inputs.name: Backend URL
inputs.description: URL of the Maestro Backend API

outputs.name: Results
outputs.description: Array of test results for each model

outputs.name: Summary
outputs.description: Summary with total models tested, success/fail counts
